LESSON: SUBTRACTION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.3: Subtraction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Subtraction. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. subtract up to two 6-digit numbers without regrouping in real-life situations
2. subtract of up to two 6-digit numbers with regrouping in different situations
3. estimate difference by rounding off the minuend and subtrahend to the nearest hundred and thousand in different situations
4. perform combined operations involving addition and subtraction in different situations
5. create patterns involving subtraction from up to 1,000,000 in different situations
6. appreciate subtraction of numbers in real-life situations. of numbers using digital devices and other resources

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT SUBTRACTION MEANS
Subtraction finds how many are left or the difference between two numbers.

WORKED EXAMPLES
A: 48 − 23 = 25
B (regrouping): 52 − 18 → ones need regrouping → 34
C: KSh 100 − KSh 35 = KSh 65 change.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: 48 − 23 = 25

Example 2: 52 − 18 = 34

Example 3: KSh 100 − KSh 35 = KSh 65

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Subtraction.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Subtraction in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. subtract up to two 6-digit numbers without regrouping in real-life situations
2. subtract of up to two 6-digit numbers with regrouping in different situations
3. estimate difference by rounding off the minuend and subtrahend to the nearest hundred and thousand in different situations
4. perform combined operations involving addition and subtraction in different situations

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
